<div class="doxyPage">

# App Volume Management




## Overview {#app_volume_overview}


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>Obtain a session (rejoin, or onboard with the hub pairing code)</li>
<li>Get-or-create a single app volume by its stable common name</li>
<li>Enumerate and inspect every app volume handle</li>
<li>Customise the volume's gesture mapping rules</li>
<li>Set and clear a world anchor</li>
<li>Map a room-space point into app content space and hit-test the cuboid</li>
</ul>

## Prerequisites {#app_volume_prereq}


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>Complete the <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/pages/qar-c-tutorial-onboarding">Onboarding and Rejoin</a> tutorial</li>
<li>A running QarOS hub (for the first run, read the pairing code off its onboarding screen)</li>
</ul>

## Build and Run {#app_volume_build}


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">cmake --build --preset x64-windows-debug --target app_volume_management</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">./build/x64-windows/Debug/app_volume_management.exe</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">&lt;path-to-qar-streaming-c.dll&gt; [runtime-dir] [pairing-code]</span></span></div>

</div>

## Customise the Gesture Configuration {#app_volume_gestures}


<p>Start from <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-defaults/#ga5d98c4f156839988e58289352ad92e54">qar_app_volume_gesture_configuration_default()</a>, which mirrors what a volume created without a configuration gets: two-hand distance -&gt; app scale, one-hand 6DoF -&gt; app pose (rotation off), hover, click. Rules are in descending priority. Change a rule in place, then replace the volume's default mode with <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-app-volumes/#ga4b7168291f07557695fc83803face6f9">qar_app_volumes_change_gesture_configuration()</a>. The same struct can instead be passed in <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarappvolumeinit/#a7603d2a0cdd8aa107197bd5a9978b99e">QarAppVolumeInit::gesture_configuration</a>, but get-or-create ignores it when the volume already exists.</p>

## Pin to the Earth with a World Anchor {#app_volume_anchor}


<p>A world anchor states where app volume space sits on the Earth, as an ECEF WGS84 frame. Here the volume's +X points east, +Y up and +Z south of a latitude/longitude, which keeps the frame right-handed.</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment">/** \brief Build an east/up/south anchor frame at a WGS84 latitude/longitude</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *  (degrees) and ellipsoid height (metres). */</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">static</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qargeoanchorframe">QarGeoAnchorFrame</a></span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight"><a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/examples/app-volume-management-c/#aa91e710b938273f1219cfade9ed20d73">geo_anchor_from_lat_lon</a>(</span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> lat_deg, </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> lon_deg, </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> height_m)</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">{</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> e2 = 6.69437999014e-3; </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">/* WGS84 first eccentricity^2 */</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> deg = 3.14159265358979323846 / 180.0;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> sin_lat = sin(lat_deg * deg);</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> cos_lat = cos(lat_deg * deg);</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> sin_lon = sin(lon_deg * deg);</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">double</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> n = a / sqrt(1.0 - e2 * sin_lat * sin_lat);</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    frame.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qargeoanchorframe/#ac07bd5f1c3f5c9d7a145be087d4d7f53">origin_world</a>.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3d/#a060c3b166df9b59e60b51315a5c2dea8">z</a> = (n * (1.0 - e2) + height_m) * sin_lat;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">/* +X east */</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    frame.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qargeoanchorframe/#aac50b3e514e19429b503f5cb6de086e9">axis_x_world</a>.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3d/#a73bfc74bd5cae9e007a16c45bc1a318c">x</a> = -sin_lon;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    frame.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qargeoanchorframe/#aac50b3e514e19429b503f5cb6de086e9">axis_x_world</a>.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3d/#ace2a55cecb5ef4812e950b81fd2baed9">y</a> = cos_lon;</span></span></div>

## Room-Space Point to App Content Space {#app_volume_hit_test}


<p>Gesture points already arrive in app content space. A point the application has only in room space - a GUI panel's position, a device pose - is mapped in two steps: room -&gt; app volume space through the volume pose, whose position is the cuboid <b>centre</b>, then app volume -&gt; app content space through the app pose and app scale. The cuboid test happens in app volume space against the half extents.</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment">/** \brief Rotate v by the inverse of the unit quaternion q. */</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">static</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3">QarVector3</a></span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight"><a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/examples/app-volume-management-c/#a153832beff30ac69c56193700ee25021">rotate_by_inverse</a>(<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarquaternion">QarQuaternion</a> q, <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3">QarVector3</a> v)</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">{</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">/* v' = v + w t + u x t with u = -q.xyz and t = 2 (u x v) */</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">float</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> ux = -q.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarquaternion/#aed738efd42014fa19df2b441a2817758">x</a>, uy = -q.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarquaternion/#a464915e95da94e85a8f9a735a95fd2c6">y</a>, uz = -q.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarquaternion/#ae97035c3e3947e062d5075630d57d19d">z</a>;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">float</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> tx = 2.0f * (uy * v.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3/#a6ebf6173153df8c50b63b842204d48b4">z</a> - uz * v.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3/#a5c6b4d03c4255d53ee7a387c500fe56b">y</a>);</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">const</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">float</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> ty = 2.0f * (uz * v.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3/#a8998e28822a8949bafd32d6fb24084a2">x</a> - ux * v.<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvector3/#a6ebf6173153df8c50b63b842204d48b4">z</a>);</span></span></div>
